market_definition: The masking tapes market comprises light-tack, easy-release tapes that protect surfaces during painting, coating, plating and other finishing operations. It measures sales of finished paper, film and cloth-based masking tapes. BY BACKING MATERIAL: Crepe Paper, Polyester / PET Film, Polyethylene & PVC Film, Fabric & Foam. BY TEMPERATURE RATING: General Purpose, Automotive / Bake-Resistant, High-Temperature. BY APPLICATION: General Painting, Automotive Refinish, Aerospace & Industrial Masking, Electronics & PCB Masking. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive Refinish, Building & Decorating, Aerospace & Defense, Electronics & PCB Manufacturing, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: General packaging and duct tapes; electrical insulation tapes; protective surface films; paints and coatings. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
